71-09-01A.t: ENG 1(2) FAN COWL NOT CLSD Alert
71-09-01A.pt: ENG 1(2) FAN COWL NOT CLSD Alert
71-09-01A.txt:
Repair interval                    Nbr installed                    Nbr required                Placard
                  C                                  2                                0                       Yes
    (o)      One or both may be displayed provided that the associated fan cowl door latches are
             checked closed before each flight.
             Note:      <After Door Closed> Crew Defer
                        Flight crew may continue flight operations after accomplishing the Crew Defer
                        procedure. (Refer to MEL Policy)
                                                       Reference(s)
          (o) Refer to OpsProc 71-09-01A ENG 1(2) FAN COWL NOT CLSD Alert
71-09-01A.ko:
(o) 매 비행 전에 해당 fan cowl door latch(팬 카울 도어 걸쇠)가 닫혀 있는지 확인한다면, 하나 또는 둘 다 표시되어도 된다.
Note: <도어 닫힌 후 발생 시> Crew Defer (승무원 이연 절차 수행 후 운항 계속 가능)
운항승무원은 Crew Defer 절차를 마친 뒤 운항을 계속할 수 있다. (MEL Policy 참조)
참조
(o) OpsProc 71-09-01A ENG 1(2) FAN COWL NOT CLSD Alert 참조 (운항 절차 — 아래 운항 절차 칸)

71-13-01A.t: Fan Cowl Loss Prevention Mechanical System
71-13-01A.pt: Fan Cowl Loss Prevention Mechanical System
71-13-01A.txt:
Repair interval                    Nbr installed                    Nbr required                Placard
                  C                                  2                                0                       Yes
    (o) (m) One or both may be inoperative provided that:
            1) The Fan Cowl Loss Prevention Mechanical system is inhibited, and
            2) The associated fan cowl latches are checked closed before each flight.
             Note:      <After Door Closed> Return To Gate
             Note:      <MAINTENANCE>
                        1. Repetitive maintenance actions required - Use the yellow defer placards and
                           make log entry.
                        2. Contact MCC for Defer Control.

                                                       Reference(s)
        (o) Refer to OpsProc 71-13-01A Fan Cowl Loss Prevention Mechanical System
        (m) Refer to AMM Task 71-13-00-040-816
71-13-01A.ko:
(o) (m) 다음 조건이면 하나 또는 둘 다 작동 불능 상태로 운항할 수 있다:
1) Fan Cowl Loss Prevention Mechanical system(팬 카울 이탈 방지 기계 장치)을 inhibit(억제)하고,
2) 매 비행 전에 해당 fan cowl latch가 닫혀 있는지 확인한다.
Note: <도어 닫힌 후 발생 시> Return To Gate (게이트로 돌아가 정비 조치 필요)
Note: <MAINTENANCE> (정비 사항)
1. 반복 정비 조치 필요 — 노란색 defer 플래카드를 사용하고 log entry를 기록한다.
2. Defer Control(이연 관리)은 MCC에 연락.
참조
(o) OpsProc 71-13-01A Fan Cowl Loss Prevention Mechanical System 참조 (운항 절차 — 아래 운항 절차 칸)
(m) AMM Task 71-13-00-040-816 참조 (정비 절차)

71-09-01A.t: ENG 1(2) FAN COWL NOT CLSD Alert
71-09-01A.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
     No restrictions.
  FLIGHT CREW
     Contact the maintenance personnel to check the associated fan cowl door latches are closed. If
     unavailable, Return To Gate.
  EXTERIOR WALKAROUND
     During the exterior walkaround, the flight crew must check carefully on both sides of each engine
     that all the fan cowl door latches are correctly closed.
     If necessary, the flight crew should use a torch and crouch to perform the check.
71-09-01A.ko:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS (비행계획 제한)
제한 없음.
FLIGHT CREW (운항승무원 조치)
정비사(maintenance personnel)에게 연락하여 해당 fan cowl door latch가 닫혀 있는지 확인하게 한다. 정비사가 없으면 Return To Gate(게이트로 돌아간다).
EXTERIOR WALKAROUND (외부 점검)
외부 점검(exterior walkaround) 중 운항승무원은 각 엔진의 양쪽에서 모든 fan cowl door latch가 올바르게 닫혀 있는지 주의 깊게 확인해야 한다.
필요하면 손전등(torch)을 사용하고 몸을 낮춰(crouch) 확인한다.
